outcome: brain oscillations (delta power, theta power, alpha power, beta power)
cohort: A Dutch cohort comprising 53 very preterm born adolescents and 61 full-term born adolescents, all aged 13 years, participated in the study.
finding: Very preterm born adolescents exhibited decreased relative beta activity and were more likely to belong to a subgroup characterized by the highest delta power and lowest theta, alpha, and beta power, which was associated with the lowest intelligence, academic, and motor estimates.
